name: Papermon
creator: Astra
notes: Papermon, a baby sac-winged bat pup (the Babbling Sac-winged Pup, Astra 2026-11-14: "a babbler, like a pet that tells you about papers"). Paper Patty, the newspaper girl, retired that day; the pet and the Papermon game share one name. His sheet was generated with scripts/generate-pets.mjs (OpenAI, gpt-image-2) from his Papermon card art as the reference. The nine plain frames (no mood stickers) are cut from that sheet with the hub's own converter (scripts/sheet-to-sprites.mjs, as scripts/build-frames.mjs does, 256px, 24 colours); idle and blink are byte-identical to art/frames/paper-girl/plain-idle.png and plain-blink.png. A draft until Astra approves it. The 2026-10-11 newspaper drawings stay in this folder as a record. The Windows desktop pet still reads idle-20261011.png and blink-20261011.png by name (scripts/desktop-pets-20261011.cs) until that list reads the newest drawing; desktop_scale and the File Master pairing are carried over from the 2026-10-11 manifest.
